items.en: Ukraine says an intercepted Russian document plans up to 1,000 missiles, drones and bombs against 60 Ukrainian infrastructure targets this winter

items.sEn: Ukraine says it has obtained a Russian plan for a winter strike campaign against its critical infrastructure. items.en: «Усі їхні тактики вже вивчені»: у 115-й бригаді розповіли про полювання на ворожі БПЛА
items.nl: "Al hun tactieken zijn al bestudeerd": 115e brigade over de jacht op vijandelijke drones
items.sEn: ArmyInform relays an interview given to Suspilne by Chief Sergeant "Hector" of a drone-interception battery in Ukraine's 115th Brigade. The unit counters Russian reconnaissance drones (Zala, Orlan, Supercam) and attack drones (Shaheds, Gerbers, Molniya).

items.en: Russia adapts to Ukraine's middle-strike drone campaign with mobile fire groups, Rubicon interceptors and Starlink jammers
